'''Bomodon''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SWTORE" /> located in the [[Bomodon system/Legends|Bomodon system]], a part of the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Bomodon (species)|Bomodon]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Tales" />

During the early stages of the [[Great Galactic War]], which began in [[3681 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] occupied Bomodon. The [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] embedded the [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Marcus Trant]], for whom it was first documented field service, on Bomodon at some point by [[3674 BBY]], and that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial military forces]] also shot down on the planet a Republic [[45th Infantry Division]] [[Elin Garza's platoon|platoon]] under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Elin Garza]]. With assistance from Trant, Garza and the surviving [[Republic soldier|soldiers]] of her stranded [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] avoided capture and, for ten subsequent [[Standard month/Legends|months]], waged a relentless improvised [[Guerrilla warfare/Legends|guerilla]] [[Battle of Bomodon|campaign]] that culminated in the liberation of Bomodon from Imperial control.<ref name="SWTORE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bomodon was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="SWTORE" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Bomodon [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet, in grid square O-15.<ref name="TEA" />
